name: Alvoy Berry Farm
description: Alvoy Berry Farm is a independent farm in Newton, GA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Pumpkins, and Corn, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
